newsitem.title: NAMIBIA: NAMIBIA STOCKS WEEK - GOLD FIELDS DOMINATES.
newsitem.headline: NAMIBIA STOCKS WEEK - GOLD FIELDS DOMINATES.

text.p: the week on the Namibian Stock Exchange with much of the 341,300
shares traded going to foreign buyers snapping up the shares at
Namibia Breweries saw lower volumes of trading and fell back
to end at N$2.75. Biggest trades by value were dual-listed
industrial group Barlow Ltd with N$15.5 million worth
of shares traded and Metropolitan Life at N$1.8 million traded.
The total value of NSE trades was N$20.1 million for a
volume of 944,500 shares traded. The NSE overall index rose to
246.44 after closing the previous Friday at 244.71, while the
NSE local index fell back to 155.65, from 158.94 previously.
